patch_description:
This version combines the faster square-hull anchoring strategy with the stronger annealed lower-tail objective from the simplex implementation. Four fixed square corners guarantee a unit convex hull, making raw triangle area exactly equal to the normalized objective and avoiding repeated hull computation during optimization.

The implementation uses stratified, random, and center-biased starts; a vectorized hybrid differential-evolution phase; annealed tail protection; and batched active-triangle local refinement. Local refinement preferentially moves points participating in the currently smallest triangles, which is substantially more effective than uniformly selecting coordinates while preserving deterministic execution through a fixed seed.
